Step Number: 3

Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a mistake during the comparison step. It incorrectly concluded that Şemsettin Baş, born on January 4, 1973, was born first, when in fact Gwenc'Hlan Le Scouëzec, born on November 11, 1929, was born first. This error occurred because the Planner misinterpreted the chronological order of the birth dates.
